The robot on timsrobot.com now moves. I added a new mod, **Living robot**:

- **Eyes follow your mouse.** They slide up to about 6 px toward the pointer, and their glow moves with them.
- **It blinks** every 2.5–6 seconds, and sometimes blinks twice.
- **Clicking it makes it hop.** It squashes, jumps about 38 px, lands, and bounces a little. It also blinks as it jumps. You can click again during a hop and it starts a new one.

**What I checked after a reload:**
- With a pretend mouse in the top-left corner, the eyes shifted up and to the left. You can see it in the screenshot.
- In the middle of a click, the robot was 37 px up.
- It blinked 6 times in 8 seconds. That's a bit more than usual because of the random double blinks.
- There were no errors, and your neon title and jelly buttons still work.

I tested with simulated mouse moves and clicks, so give it a real wiggle to see how it feels.

**To undo it,** switch off "Living robot" in the side panel, or ask me to.
